subject.title: feat: disable automatic session resets by default

question: Should upgrading an existing unconfigured installation intentionally change its default from daily 04:00 local session rollover to indefinite rolling continuity until manual or explicitly configured reset?
rationale: This is a deliberate persisted-session and operator-expectation change; the PR body asserts owner approval, but the supplied public discussion contains no independently verifiable maintainer decision and the item has a protected `maintainer` label.

options.title: Confirm rolling-session default
options.body: Accept `mode: "none"` as the unconfigured upgrade default after the requested real behavior and upgrade evidence is available.

options.title: Preserve current default
options.body: Keep daily rollover for unconfigured existing users and require an explicit reset configuration to opt into indefinite continuity.

recommendation.title: Confirm rolling-session default
recommendation.body: Accept `mode: "none"` as the unconfigured upgrade default after the requested real behavior and upgrade evidence is available.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied context identifies steipete as the policy-change author and records the change as owner-approved, though repository history could not be checked.
